subject: Renewal proposal: surge safeguard + commit-tiering (OxygenAI)
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@oxygenai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal: surge safeguard + commit-tiering (OxygenAI)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the candid conversation last week. As OxygenAI looks to finalize the Jan renewal, I wanted to put a concise proposal on the table that balances predictability for you and flexibility for spikes in inference consumption.

High level (attached: 20261208_oxygenai_pricing_v2.pdf + surge_safeguard_matrix.xlsx):
- 12‑month renewal starting 2027-01-01 with three commit tiers (Base / Growth / Surge).
- Stepwise discounts tied to commit bands: 0-100k tokens/mo (base), 100k-400k (growth), 400k+ (surge).
- Surge safeguard: short-term consumption above 400k/mo is billed at a guarded uplift rather than full overage, capped to 2x the base rate for a 7‑day window.
- Bridge credit: one-time $25k credit to smooth the transition to the Growth tier if you agree to the 12‑month term and 90% forecast accuracy target.
- Optional 30‑day price hold on the Growth tier if signed before 2026-12-31.

Ask: Can you confirm an initial forecast (Dec estimate + Jan target) so we can surface the exact dollar impact for the finance team? If you’re ok, we’ll loop in Aditya for approvals and generate a DocuSign.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: 20261208_oxygenai_pricing_v2.pdf (proposal, 5 pages)
Attachment: surge_safeguard_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@oxygenai.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Fields <connor.fields@oxygenai.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: surge safeguard + commit-tiering (OxygenAI)

Nikhil —

Appreciate the clear write-up. A few quick clarifications from our side before we take this to procurement and finance: 

1) The $25k bridge credit — is that refundable against true‑up or only applied as a prepayment credit? We prefer something that flows into true‑up so credits reduce any overage invoices.
2) For the surge safeguard, can you confirm the reporting granularity? We need daily visibility and a single contact for near-real-time throttling requests if we see an unexpected model release driving traffic.
3) The 90% forecast accuracy target — that seems aggressive given our new features. Could we trade that for a higher initial Growth tier commitment for the first two months?

Connor and I prefer a short call to walk through the matrix. Are you available Friday morning (12/4) PST?

Thanks,
Sara Lim
Head of BizOps | OxygenAI
sara.lim@oxygenai.com

Sara / Connor —

Thanks for the quick reply — Friday 10:30am PST works for me. I pulled Monica and Aditya in to make sure we can move fast on contract language and the credit mechanics. Quick answers ahead of the call: 

- Bridge credit mechanics: the $25k would be applied as a credit toward your first two invoices and remain available to offset true-ups for the term. We can make it explicit in the SOW that credits reduce invoice balances before applying overage rates.
- Reporting / throttling: we can provide daily usage feeds (S3 or Pull API) + a pager contact for immediate mitigation. Monica will own the operational runbook.
- Forecast target: we can replace the 90% accuracy clause with a 2‑month elevated Growth commitment (100k–250k tokens/mo floor) and then revert to the original forecast cadence for month 3+. The surge safeguard triggers remain the same.

On the call we’ll walk the surge matrix and show line-item impact for the three commit bands; I’ve attached a version of the matrix that highlights the 2‑month elevated floor.

See you Friday — dial-in in the calendar invite.

Best,
Nikhil

Nikhil / Monica —

Quick follow-up after our exec sync: the leadership team is comfortable with the 12‑month term, the two‑month elevated Growth floor, and the bridge credit mechanics as you described. A few items procurement asked to be explicit in the SOW before signature:

• Credit application language (credits apply to invoices and true-ups, non-refundable).
• Surge reporting endpoint and 1‑hour response SLA to throttling requests.
• DocuSign-ready SOW with the option to renew at the same Growth tier pricing if signed before 2027-12-31.

We’re ready to proceed pending those edits — I’ll sign once the final SOW hits DocuSign. Attaching the procurement checklist as context.

Thanks for moving quickly; Connor will be the internal lead for onboarding.

Best,
Sara
